# Amirhossein Shorakaei - Portfolio & Services

> Amirhossein Shorakaei is a professional web designer and developer based in Tehran, Iran. He specializes in creating custom, high-performance websites using Next.js, React, and AI technologies.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://shorakaei.ir/): Introduction to Amirhossein and his portfolio.
- [Services](https://shorakaei.ir/services): Overview of all professional services offered.
- [Portfolio](https://shorakaei.ir/work): Selected case studies and past projects.
- [Blog](https://shorakaei.ir/blog): Articles and insights on web design, SEO, and AI.
- [Order](https://shorakaei.ir/order): Contact page and project request form.

## Core Services
- [Custom Web Design](https://shorakaei.ir/services/web-design): Building unique, fast, and responsive websites from scratch.
- [AI-Powered Websites](https://shorakaei.ir/services/ai-website): Integrating AI for content generation and speed.
- [AI Advertising Banners](https://shorakaei.ir/services/ai-banner): Creating unique visual assets for campaigns.
- [AI Video Production](https://shorakaei.ir/services/ai-video): Cinematic video creation using AI tools.
